title: Toddler Easter Basket, Garden Pond Patio - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century candid snapshot of a curly-haired toddler wearing a lightweight summer sunsuit or romper holding a small wire-handled basket filled with eggs. The toddler stands along a stone pathway bordering an ornamental rock garden pond in an enclosed backyard courtyard or patio behind a stucco residence. The bright outdoor lighting casts strong shadows, capturing an enduring childhood tradition of the Easter egg hunt.
